description: This header file declares the interface for a platform-specific filesystem monitor listener that interacts with a daemon backend in a version control system's fsmonitor component. It includes function prototypes for constructor, destructor, main event loop, and asynchronous stop functions, conditioned on the presence of the HAVE_FSMONITOR_DAEMON_BACKEND macro.

methods.name: fsm_listen__ctor
methods.description: Initializes platform-specific data for the fsmonitor listener thread. Called before starting the listener thread.

methods.name: fsm_listen__dtor
methods.description: Cleans up platform-specific data for the fsmonitor listener thread. Called after the listener thread has been joined.

methods.name: fsm_listen__loop
methods.description: Runs the platform-specific event loop to watch for filesystem events in the listener thread.

methods.name: fsm_listen__stop_async
methods.description: Requests that the listener thread shutdown asynchronously without waiting for it to stop.
